name: DumbVoice
description: Local dictation, personal vocabulary, and a little less typing.
note: Choose a built DumbVoice bin folder. Installation copies the app into DumbManager; it does not start recording.

name: DumbLighting
description: Six quiet lighting presets that follow what you’re doing.
note: Choose the effects folder. DumbManager keeps a local copy; import its HTML effects in SignalRGB to use them.

name: DumbEffects
description: A home for the effects toolkit. More on this one soon.
note: No installable package has been published yet.

name: GitHub API
description: Repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions from your own tools.
setup: Create a fine-grained token with the smallest repository permissions your feature needs. Follow the REST quickstart; keep the token in your app’s secret store.

name: Roblox Open Cloud
description: Publish places and work with experiences, assets and data stores.
setup: Create an Open Cloud API key for your experience and chosen scopes. Use the official endpoint reference for your feature.

name: Discord API
description: Bots, interactions and useful community automations.
setup: Create an application in the Discord developer portal. Configure only the intents and permissions your integration needs.

name: TypeSafe
description: Typed AI judgments for routing, ranking and small decisions.
setup: Follow TypeSafe’s current SDK documentation and configure your own key in your app’s secret store.
